answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 148089 Country: India Title: I want to know what is the ruling for missing Sunnah-e-Muwakkadah namaz after obligatory prayers. Question: I want to know what is the ruling for missing Sunnah-e-Muwakkadah namaz after obligatory prayers. Answer ID: 148089 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 451/402/H=5/1438) If it is missed due to some excuse or need by chance then there is no harm but it is sin to make it a habit and there is fear that such person shall be deprived of the intercession of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him).
